g.text: Puls in Azure: the build and the verbs
the verbs read the outputs back
settings and the env files to
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: one deployment, puls-build, creates what is missing and updates what exists, and the verbs do what a template can't. They read its
outputs back: vmPrivateIp, environmentId, environmentStaticIp, sqlServerFqdn, appIdentityId, codingAppIdentityId and vaultUri.
